verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents one-off, user-initiated workflows such as board consents, convertible notes and ASC 718 report generation, plus event-driven automation like the data room collecting documents and the Gusto sync. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to schedule jobs or workflows to run on a recurring basis. Predefined vesting schedules describe equity vesting terms, not job scheduling, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
